# GlassFolio

> GlassFolio is an encrypted multi-asset wealth tracker. It tracks PEA, CTO, crypto, life insurance and savings accounts in an AES-256-GCM encrypted vault, with a modular tax engine (French rules built in), ETF fee analysis and an AI assistant. It runs self-hosted with Docker or as a managed cloud version. It is an independent project and does not provide tax or investment advice.

Key facts:
- Encryption: records are encrypted in the browser with AES-256-GCM; the key is derived from the user's password with PBKDF2-SHA256 (600,000 iterations) and HKDF. Keys are never sent to a server.
- Editions: self-hosted (Docker, free for personal use, data stays on your disk, listens on 127.0.0.1 by default) and cloud at app.glassfolio.dev (free, encrypted vault stored in Supabase with row-level security).
- Tax engine: French rules built in; compares flat tax (PFU) with the progressive scale; prepares Cerfa 2042, 2074 and 3916 boxes. Designed to add other jurisdictions.
- Imports: CSV from BoursoBank, Trade Republic, Binance, Kraken, Bitget and Coinbase; duplicates skipped; imports can be rolled back.
- AI: tools callable by the in-app assistant and by MCP clients such as Claude Desktop and Cursor; read-only unless the user confirms. Models: local Ollama, or your own API key (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Groq, OpenRouter).
- Languages: English and French. Themes: light, dark, midnight.
